findings.title: The finite sea remains a gatherable totality
findings.claim: The sea is not only a large reservoir: in the pericope it can be read as a finite, dynamic totality whose parts move into parts, whose water can be supplemented, and whose whole remains gatherable, while the Lord's words exceed that entire finite arrangement.
findings.mechanism: The focus forms naming the sea and added supply carry the material field; 18:99 supplies parts, interpenetrating motion, and gathering as independent triggers. Their contact changes the comparison from a static quantity to every rearrangement and aggregation of a bounded field.
findings.reader_payoff: The added sea is newly perceptible as continuation within one finite system rather than as a second isolated number, so the words outrun a system even when it shifts, combines, and is replenished.
findings.containment: This remains an attributed contextual resonance. 18:99 may remain an eschatological gathering without a hydrological claim; the finding does not replace the plain sea-and-ink comparison or assert a literal physical process.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 18:99 anchors and all trace coordinates are supplied, but the HFT reader identity is legacy_unbound and the contextual mapping is an attributed nomination.

findings.title: Exhaustion belongs to the receiving channel
findings.claim: The pericope places the limit in finite display and reception: an exposed sign can meet covered sight and failed hearing, so sea-ink is a maximal carrier that runs out without making the Lord's address run out.
findings.mechanism: The focus words are carried through the sea-ink image, while 18:100-101 move from display to covered eyes, blocked remembrance, and inability to hear. The contact relocates failure from the speaking source to the finite sensory and representational channel.
findings.reader_payoff: The depletion of the sea no longer suggests silence or scarcity in the source; it shows the finitude of whatever receives, records, or hears.
findings.containment: The surrounding verses may still describe the condemned audience without redefining the focus analogy. This finding does not deny the plain quantitative comparison and does not claim that every reception failure is identical.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 18:100-101 anchors and word coordinates are supplied, while the HFT contextual synthesis remains legacy-unbound and attributed.

findings.mechanism: The focus supplies the material expenditure, depletion, and meaningful-word carrier; 18:103-104 supply failed work, misdirected striving, false confidence, and skilled making. Their contact distinguishes the amount of production from arrival at its object.
findings.reader_payoff: The imagined sea becomes a measure of consumed labor as well as material volume, clarifying why more writing is not automatically more understanding.
findings.containment: The surrounding works passage may remain an ethical contrast rather than a direct interpretation of the metaphor. The finding does not say that writing is futile or that the focus's quantitative force disappears.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 18:103-104 anchors support the trace, but the HFT projection and its analogy are legacy-unbound and attributed.

findings.title: Volume cannot become a measure of the source
findings.claim: The sea and its ink can be measured as material volume, but the words, signs, and delivered message do not become commensurable entries in that finite accounting frame.

findings.reader_payoff: The comparison becomes more than a large number: it shows why no physical scale can be the right unit for the signifying and evaluative source.
findings.containment: The 18:105 connection is retained as counter-evidence noting no clear direct link; this finding remains a qualified HFT overlay and does not erase the focus's quantitative assertion or apply weighing to the words literally.

epistemic.reason: The focus and contextual anchors are exact, but the HFT projection is legacy_unbound and the 18:105 connection carries explicit no-value counter-evidence.

findings.title: Media enter turnover while the words do not
findings.claim: The immediately preceding abiding state gives the focus a temporal contrast: media pass, empty, and require replacement, while the Lord's words remain outside that turnover.
findings.mechanism: 18:108 supplies persistence without seeking a change of place or state; the focus supplies before, depletion, and added duration. The contact turns inexhaustibility into a contrast between what undergoes transition and what does not.
findings.reader_payoff: The words' not-ending becomes newly perceptible as nontransition, not merely as an indefinitely large quantity.
findings.containment: 18:108 may describe only the inhabitants' contentment rather than the ontology of the words. The finding keeps that alternative open and does not replace the focus's explicit depletion sequence.

epistemic.reason: The exact 18:108 and focus coordinates support the temporal contact, while the HFT reader identity and synthesis are legacy_unbound.

findings.title: Likeness belongs to finite bearers
findings.claim: The next ayah makes the analogy's boundary visible: sea may be like sea and a human may be like the audience as finite bearers, but neither finite bearer resembles the one source in role or contains the Lord's words.
findings.mechanism: The focus's sea, ink, words, and likeness contact 18:110's repeated command, human likeness, revelation, divine unity, and ban on partnership. The paired likenesses therefore police mediation rather than merely adding another quantity.
findings.reader_payoff: The added sea becomes a carrier comparable to another carrier, while the source-to-bearer distinction remains protected through the closing human messenger scene.
findings.containment: The two uses of likeness may be read independently; this finding presents their shared mediating boundary as an attributed synthesis and does not claim that a finite bearer exhausts or equals the source.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 18:110 anchors strongly specify the contact, but the HFT identity is legacy_unbound and the shared mediation relation remains attributed.

findings.title: Inexhaustibility still permits response
findings.claim: The words need not be fully transcribed in order to be truly received and answered: the inexhaustible source can meet a bounded human utterance, fitting action, and exclusive worship.
findings.mechanism: The focus's command and meaningful words contact 18:110's received revelation and finite imperatives to act fittingly and worship without association. The next ayah supplies a bounded response rather than requiring total capture of the source.
findings.reader_payoff: The impossible task of exhausting the words no longer leaves only contemplation of scale; it opens a concrete mode of response that remains finite and genuine.
findings.containment: 18:110 may be a separate practical conclusion rather than a direct resolution of the inscription paradox. The finding does not claim that a finite response contains all the words or replaces the plain comparison.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 18:110 coordinates support the transition, while the HFT synthesis is legacy_unbound and attributed.

branch_activations.carrier: 18:110 carries the prohibition on multiplying rival sources.

branch_activations.activation: Exclusive relation turns the response toward the one source without requiring exhaustive possession.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A bounded response can remain truly directed to an inexhaustible source.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved branch is attributed and does not redefine worship in the focus.

branch_activations.activation: Fitting action provides correspondence without claiming exhaustive representation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A response can be adequate without containing the whole source.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved contextual branch is attributed.

findings.title: A drained reservoir as an exploratory echo of voided deeds
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the focus's drained sea echoes 18:105's voided deeds as a reservoir whose apparent yield has disappeared: material supply and human yield can enter an economy of loss, while the Lord's words do not.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies the broad sea and explicit depletion; 18:105 supplies failed deeds and the attributed well-loss branch. Their contact creates a hydraulic overlay on the result of deeds, not a replacement for the surface meaning of the deeds phrase.
findings.reader_payoff: The contrast between finite yield and inexhaustible words becomes visible across the adjacent judgment language without turning the focus into a direct judgment on deeds.
findings.containment: This is surprising and exploratory. The surface 18:105 verb applies to deeds and need not evoke a well; the 18:105 reciprocal connection records no clear direct link. The overlay remains bounded to the repeated depletion image.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 18:105 coordinates and the supplied HFT containment are present, but the HFT record is legacy_unbound, exploratory, and opposed by a no-value reciprocal connection.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Cok ve genis suyun yayilmasi, büyük su kütlesi ve büyük irimak anlamlarini birlestiren cekirdektir.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 18:105 carries deeds whose apparent result is voided.
branch_activations.activation: The drained-reservoir image contacts the focus sea through the explicit depletion relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The sea can serve as the finite side of a contrast with disappearing human yield.
branch_activations.boundary: The reservoir image is exploratory and does not replace the plain sea referent.

branch_activations.activation: The contextual well-loss branch contacts the focus through shared finite depletion and reservoir structure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Failed deeds can be viewed, exploratorily, as yield drained from a finite reservoir.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is unresolved and attributed; 18:105's surface sense remains voided deeds, not a well.

branch_activations.carrier: 18:105 carries intentional deeds as the human product subjected to loss.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Human yield may vanish in the same contextual contrast in which the sea is depleted, while the words are not.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that the focus directly means deeds or that the overlay is established lexical sense.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Tükenmenin o şeyin sürekliliğini kesip sona erdirmesi.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus depletion forms carry the sea's finite loss.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 18:105 supplies voided deeds and the attributed reservoir-loss image.
branch_activations.activation: The explicit depletion relation lets the contextual deed-loss image return through the focus's sea and depletion forms.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Finite material and human yield can disappear together in the exploratory overlay, while the words are not placed in that loss.
branch_activations.boundary: The depletion branch remains the ordinary focus relation; only the deed-reservoir contact is exploratory.

findings.title: The external Lordship overlay widens the referent
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:2 overlay makes the focus's 'my Lord' contact a universal lordship relation: the source named in the sea comparison is also described as Lord of all worlds.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier `رَبِّي` returns through its two focus occurrences, while 1:2 supplies the separate `رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ` trigger. The added phrase contributes the specific scope 'all worlds' and therefore widens the referent beyond a speaker-only possessive relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The possessive in the focus can be heard as a relation held by the speaker without narrowing the Lord's domain; the words' inexhaustibility is placed against universal lordship.
findings.containment: This is an external, qualified overlay, not a replacement translation of `رَبِّي` and not a claim that every Fātiḥa theme applies here. The other added ayat are not retained because they supplied no distinct focus-returning delta beyond the native/pericope findings.

epistemic.reason: The focus and external Arabic occurrences are directly supplied, but the cross-ayah semantic widening is an authorial overlay rather than a supplied candidate or independent lexical finding.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Mutlak adlandırma Tanrı'ya özgüdür; insan için kullanım belirtilmiş bir şeye bağlıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus's repeated my Lord forms carry the divine lordship relation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 1:2 names the Lord as Lord of all worlds.
branch_activations.activation: The external universal-domain phrase contacts the focus's possessive Lordship relation and widens its contextual scope.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The source of the inexhaustible words is related to the speaker as my Lord while being named over all worlds.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the supplied 1:2 lordship scope is added; no whole-surah overlay or new branch gloss is claimed.

friction_notes: All nine supplied candidates are legacy_unbound HFT nominations. Their exact coordinates, before/after readings, and roles are retained as attributed evidence with qualified or exploratory status rather than treated as independent lexical proof.

The 18:105 drained-reservoir finding remains exploratory because the supplied HFT containment limits it to a hydraulic overlay on voided deeds, while the reciprocal connection records no clear direct link.

Phase 1 quarantined the explicitly added 1:2-1:7 ayat. Phase 2 retained only the distinct 1:2 contact through the focus's رَبِّي; 1:3-1:7 supplied no additional non-duplicative focus-returning semantic delta.
